y05ym640.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
y05ym640.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
y05ym640.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Hinged construction for set up lightweight and break-resistant Number of PVC tips: 380 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 1000 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

q8qjrt9w.baseName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
q8qjrt9w.variantName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
q8qjrt9w.sourceDescription: Packed with character, the Snowy Scots Pine is one of our most charming trees. Unlike plain green Christmas trees, the Snowy Scots Pine comes with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches which draw the eye without stealing the show from your favourite festive decorations. The range is also the perfect choice for those unsure about going for a fully frosted Christmas tree. Where an all-over flocked tree could perhaps be a little too 'modern' for some tastes, the Snowy Scots Pine expertly balances the old with the new, providing a timeless artificial tree that all Christmas guests will adore. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. And let's not forget the very best bit the Snowy Scots tree comes with pre-attached pine cones! It's this final festive flourish that makes it one of our most unique collections - and a favourite among the kids! Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 9ft • Number of Branch Tips: 1982 branch tips • Tree Width: 158cm diameter • Foliage colour: Green with light flocking and frosting • Realistic look: A stunning mix of PE/PVC and large bottle brush branch tips • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Picture shows 7ft Model • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
